candidates.source_attribution: Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan I-III (Three Books of Meqabyan, መጽሐፈ መቃብያን) — Tewahedo broader-canon Ethiopian Maccabees, distinct from the Greek LXX 1-4 Maccabees (different content; shared title only). English translation from the Modern Amharic of the EOTC Bible (nehemiah-osc.org) by Claude (Anthropic) with collaborator, May 2026. Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication (archive.org/details/three-books-of-meqabyan-cc0-translation). Apparatus integrates Josef Horovitz, 'Das äthiopische Maccabäerbuch,' Zeitschrift für Assyriologie XIX (1905), pp. 194-233 — PD primary scholarly study. 64-citation third-pass audit verdict matrix; 57 verified, 4 errors corrected, 3 interpretive readings flagged, 7 newly discovered parallels added. Dating widened to Aksumite-to-Solomonic Ethiopian Christian range (4th-14th c. CE); precise composition date undetermined in current scholarship per Horovitz 1905 non-commitment. Three books: 1 Mq 36 chapters (Maqabis-of-Benjamin martyrology vs Ṣiruṣaydan); 2 Mq 21 chapters (Maqabis-of-Moab conversion + sons' martyrdom + Ṣiruṣaydan's death); 3 Mq 10 chapters (homiletic + angelological dialogue + Satan-refused-Adam tradition + resurrection-doctrine).

OPENS Ch 35 — HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR: penultimate chapter, immediately before final-resurrection-capstone (Ch 36 seed: 36:22 Abraham-my-friend + 36:29 Hellenistic-deity dating-anchor + 36:45 resurrection-tricolon capstone + γ.4.8.B 36:1 Macedonia/Amalekites + 36:43 Gen 15:6 Abraham-believed-God). The penultimate-chapter likely serves as DOXOLOGICAL-PREPARATION for the final-capstone — paralleling the trilogy's structural-rhythm of intermediate-doxology + transition-to-final-arc. The penultimate-chapter pattern parallels: PSALM 149-150 (the Psalter's penultimate + final praise-psalms); REVELATION 21 (the penultimate-revelation preparation for Ch 22's coming-Lord doxology); 1 ENOCH 107 (the penultimate-Enoch chapter preparing 108's final-doxology — γ.4.4 structure); JUBILEES 49 (the penultimate-Jubilees chapter preparing 50's final-Sabbath-doxology — γ.4.5 structure). The Meqabyan penultimate-chapter likely articulates the final-faithfulness-summons before the resurrection-capstone declares the consequence.

The final-exhortation theme parallels: DEUTERONOMY 30:11-20 (Moses's-final-exhortation-to-choose-life); JOSHUA 24:14-15 ('choose you this day whom ye will serve'); 1 SAMUEL 12:20-25 (Samuel's-farewell-address); 2 TIMOTHY 4:1-8 (Paul's-final-charge); 2 PETER 1:12-15 + 3:14-18 (Peter's-final-reminder); JUDE 17-25 (the final-doxological-exhortation); REVELATION 22:11-21 (the final-revelation-exhortation). Patristic-tradition: IGNATIUS OF ANTIOCH Letters (the seven-letters'-final-exhortations); CLEMENT 65 (the closing-doxological-exhortation); POLYCARP To the Philippians 14 (the final-exhortation pattern). Tewahedo confessional-tradition preserves the final-exhortation-to-faithfulness as the structural-anchor of catechetical-baptismal preparation. The Meqabyan chapter likely articulates the final-exhortation gathering the trilogy's themes into faithfulness-unto-resurrection.
